name: fec
description: FEC.gov campaign finance data (via the public OpenFEC API at api.open.fec.gov/v1). The CLI covers candidate and committee lookups, fundraising and spending totals, itemized receipts and disbursements, outside spending, filings, elections, calendars and advisory opinions.

commands.verifyNote: write: dry-run preview only, not sent

notes: Almost every command calls the public OpenFEC API (api.open.fec.gov/v1) using the api_key embedded in fec.gov's own web app. If you hit rate limits, swap in your own key from api.data.gov or use DEMO_KEY.
IDs: candidate IDs look like S8GA00180 / H8NY15148 / P...; committee IDs look like C00718866. Look them up with search-candidate-names or search-committee-names.

list-receipts and list-disbursements use keyset pagination. To get the next page, pass both cursor values from pagination.last_indexes: last_index plus last_contribution_receipt_date (receipts) or last_disbursement_date (disbursements).
Office codes differ by endpoint. Totals and aggregates use P/S/H. Race-level endpoints (list-election-candidates, outside spending, export) use president/senate/house.
cycle is the even year that ends the two-year period. election_full=true covers the full election period (6 years for Senate, 4 for President).
Two browse pages, /data/receipts/individual-contributions/ and /data/candidates/, are blocked by robots.txt. The same data comes from list-receipts and the totals commands.
Legal search (/data/legal/search) was recorded only as a server-rendered page without a usable structure, so it is not covered. Get individual advisory opinions with get-advisory-opinion.
export-election-candidates was not sent during recording. It queues a CSV download task and does not change any FEC data.
